From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-12T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Candidate Alex Jensen — comp bands and LM calibration (L4/L5/L6)

Neha / Laura — I ran Alex's profile vs our comp bands (attached spreadsheet: comp-band-L4-L6.xlsx). Short summary:

- L4 (mid IC): Base $150k–170k; total on-target (including equity) roughly $210k–260k.
- L5 (senior IC): Base $170k–200k; target total comp $260k–360k (equity range drives variance).
- L6 (principal): Base $200k–240k; target total comp $360k–520k.

Manager deltas (L5 manager vs L5 IC):
- Expect +10–15% on base and a moderate bump in RSU allocation; sign-on typically smaller. Manager role premium is tied to direct reports scope.

For Alex specifically, based on experience and signal from interviews, recommended share: offer in the L5 band midpoint — e.g., base $185k, RSU 0.25% 4yr with 1yr cliff, and a $20k sign-on to bridge counteroffers. If candidate expresses interest in people-management, consider an L5 manager package: base $195k + same RSU bucket + smaller sign-on.

Notes:
- We should confirm manager approval for any permanent manager offer (headcount move). For now, comp team will approve an IC L5 offer at the numbers above; manager-level offer requires explicit headcount approval from People Ops and the hiring rubric.
- Attached: comp-band-L4-L6.xlsx and a draft offer template (offer-template-IC-manager.docx).

Markus
Compensation & People Analytics Partner
Redwood Inference

Thanks team — quick decision so we don't lose the candidate. My view:

- Approve the L5 IC offer at Markus' suggested midpoint (base $185k, RSU 0.25% 4y, $20k sign-on). Give Sylvia a final calibrated band to present.
- Do NOT surface a manager offer yet. If Alex asks about manager track, present it as a growth path contingent on 6–12 month scope and a formal promotion loop. That avoids immediate manager-headcount approvals.
- If candidate strongly prefers manager title and will decline otherwise, authorize a one-time exception: we can fast-track manager-headcount approval but require Neha to send a short justification + org plan to People Ops.

Neha — please confirm you will move forward with the L5 IC offer and I will sign off so Markus can process the formal offer document.

Marissa
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
